newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Instrument sees Q4 above estimates.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Instrument sees Q4 above estimates.

text.p: Thermo Instrument Systems Inc said Wednesday it expects to beat Wall Street stock analysts' estimates for fourth quarter earnings by at least 10 percent.
The average estimate for primary earnings per share by stock analysts, as reported by First Call, is $0.30 for the fourth quarter ended December 28, the company noted.

Thermo Instrument said it anticipates reporting operating income for the quarter was 32 percent over the $0.24 per share reported for 1995's final quarter. The company intends to announce its quarterly and year-end earnings on March 20.
